entries.clue: Dense-petalled bloom lifted and stored over winter
Star-named daisy-like bloom of late summer
Lattice frame up which a climber is trained
Hindi-named jarful, thick and dark, for cold meat or a hunk of cheese
Plucky little cairn terrier who leaps out of the basket and runs for home
Abrasive ball of steel mesh, the last job of the evening
Green gem that gives the glittering city at the end of the bricks its name
Wicked enchantress with green skin who melts when a pail of water hits her
Hard outer layer of pork, scored across so the fat can render out
Black greasy film off the underside of the lid, murder on a shirt
Good witch who floats down in a bubble, crowned and gowned in spangled pink
Rusty-spiked weed of field margins; as a verb, to cut a tail short
